name: Wow Classic Burger
description: Our signature smash-patty beef burger with lettuce, tomato, caramelised onion, gherkin and Wow special sauce.

name: Double Smash Burger
description: Double smashed beef patties, cheddar cheese, crispy bacon bits, pickles and smoky BBQ sauce.

name: Spicy Fire Burger
description: Crispy fried chicken patty tossed in fiery habanero sauce, jalapeños, coleslaw and sriracha mayo.

name: Veggie Wow Burger
description: Crispy black-bean & chickpea patty with avocado, fresh greens, tomato and garlic aioli.

name: Mushroom Swiss Burger
description: Juicy beef patty topped with sautéed mushrooms, Swiss cheese, caramelised onion and truffle mayo.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic Neapolitan-style pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and fresh basil.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
description: Smoky BBQ sauce base with grilled chicken strips, red onion, corn, jalapeño and mozzarella.

name: Meat Feast Pizza
description: Loaded with beef mince, chicken sausage, pepperoni, bacon and a four-cheese blend on a rich tomato base.

name: Wow Club Sandwich
description: Triple-deck toasted sandwich with grilled chicken, crispy bacon, cheddar, lettuce, tomato and mayo.

name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
description: Golden fried chicken fillet with pickles, shredded cabbage and honey mustard in a toasted brioche bun.

name: Veggie Sub
description: Grilled vegetables, hummus, fresh greens, sundried tomatoes and pesto in a toasted baguette.

name: Crispy Fried Chicken (4 pcs)
description: Juicy bone-in chicken pieces in a seasoned crispy crust served with dipping sauce and coleslaw.

name: Grilled Chicken Platter
description: Half grilled chicken marinated in herbs and lemon, served with garlic bread, salad and fries.

name: Chicken Wings (8 pcs)
description: Tossed in your choice of BBQ, buffalo hot or honey garlic sauce. Served with blue cheese dip.

name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Marinated grilled chicken strips with garlic sauce, pickled vegetables and fresh tomato in flatbread.

name: Beef Shawarma
description: Thinly-sliced spiced beef, tahini, parsley, tomato and chilli sauce wrapped in warm flatbread.

name: Wow Fries (Large)
description: Thick-cut golden fries seasoned with our house spice blend and served with ketchup and Wow sauce.

name: Loaded Cheese Fries
description: Crispy fries smothered in melted cheddar sauce, jalapeños and spring onion.

name: Onion Rings
description: Crispy battered onion rings served with smoky chipotle dip.

name: Wow Signature Milkshake
description: Thick, creamy milkshake in vanilla, chocolate, strawberry or caramel. Blended fresh to order.

name: Fresh Mango Juice
description: Freshly blended ripe Ethiopian mangoes with a hint of lime. Pure. No added sugar.

name: Avocado Juice
description: Rich and creamy fresh avocado blended with milk and a touch of honey. A beloved Ethiopian classic.

name: Layered Fruit Juice
description: Stunning layers of avocado, mango, papaya and strawberry juices — Ethiopia's most iconic refreshment.

name: Ethiopian Coffee (Macchiato)
description: Strong traditional Ethiopian espresso with a touch of steamed milk. Short and bold.

name: Spris (Mixed Juice)
description: The classic Addis Ababa mix of avocado and papaya juices blended in a tall glass. Always a winner.

name: Still / Sparkling Water
description: Chilled bottled water — still or sparkling. Ambo mineral water available.

name: Soft Drinks (Can)
description: Coca-Cola, Pepsi, Sprite, Fanta Orange or Fanta Blackcurrant — served ice cold.

name: Hot Chocolate
description: Rich and velvety hot chocolate made with real cocoa powder and steamed milk. Perfect for a cozy evening.

name: Lemon Mint Cooler
description: Fresh lemon juice with mint leaves, a pinch of ginger and sparkling water over crushed ice.
